items.text: Rick Ryan is the Democratic State Representative for the 36th District, serving since January 2025. An attorney for over thirty years, he graduated from DePaul University and John Marshall Law School. The Illinois Supreme Court censured him in 2013 for withdrawing his legal fees before depositing a client's settlement funds.

sentences.text: Rick Ryan is the Democratic State Representative for the 36th District, serving since January 2025.
An attorney for over thirty years, he graduated from DePaul University and John Marshall Law School.
The Illinois Supreme Court censured him in 2013 for withdrawing his legal fees before depositing a client's settlement funds.

items.text: He sponsored a bill allowing public defenders to represent DUI clients in both criminal and civil hearings, and a measure addressing junk fees that he says cost consumers an estimated $3,000 every year. In May 2026, he voted to establish the Reproductive Health Records Privacy Act and to reform guardianship procedures for adults with disabilities. He sponsored HB4793, a law concerning pharmacists' ability to dispense medications.
